brief:
A former Google employee told Middle East Eye that the Israeli military is "massively dependent on Amazon and Google" in its war on Gaza. The employee, identified as Gabi, now works with an advocacy group opposing tech industry support for the military campaign.

The comment adds to a growing debate over major tech companies' role in supplying infrastructure and services used in military operations in the Palestinian territory.
